result.instructions: Tools for Roadmunk, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List my roadmaps and tell me which ones changed this month."; "Show all items on the Q1 product roadmap that have no end date."; "Create a milestone called 'Public beta' on the Platform roadmap for 2027-03-01.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Roadmunk data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run roadmunk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run roadmunk_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run roadmunk_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. roadmunk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: roadmunk_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Get the Roadmunk account: company name, billing contact and plan (package limits). Good first call to confirm the connection. GraphQL: account.

tools.name: roadmunk_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users of the account with role and last login. Optionally filter by role or a search string. GraphQL: users.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

account_roles.description: Only users with one of these roles.

search.description: Search string for name or email.

tools.name: roadmunk_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id. GraphQL: user(userID).

user_id.description: The user id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

tools.name: roadmunk_list_roadmaps
tools.title: List roadmaps
tools.description: List roadmaps with title and last update (milliseconds since Unix epoch). Optionally search by title. Archived roadmaps are left out unless asked. GraphQL: roadmaps.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

search.description: Search string for the roadmap title.

tools.name: roadmunk_get_roadmap
tools.title: Get a roadmap
tools.description: Get one roadmap by id, with its first 50 fields, items and milestones (hasMore says if more exist). Use roadmunk_list_items / roadmunk_list_milestones for more. GraphQL: roadmap(roadmapID).

roadmap_id.description: The roadmap id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

tools.name: roadmunk_list_items
tools.title: List or search roadmap items
tools.description: Search roadmap items by text, optionally inside one roadmap. An item has dates or a bucket (time period), not both. GraphQL: items.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

tools.name: roadmunk_get_item
tools.title: Get a roadmap item
tools.description: Get one item by id with its field values, key dates, parent and sub-items (first 50 of each; if hasMore is true, pass a higher nested_offset to read the next 50 of every list). GraphQL: item(itemID).

item_id.description: The item id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

nested_offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

tools.name: roadmunk_list_milestones
tools.title: List or search milestones
tools.description: Search milestones by text, optionally inside one roadmap. A milestone has one date. GraphQL: milestones.

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

tools.name: roadmunk_get_milestone
tools.title: Get a milestone
tools.description: Get one milestone by id with its field values (first 50; if hasMore is true, pass a higher fields_offset). GraphQL: milestone(milestoneID).

milestone_id.description: The milestone id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

fields_offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

tools.name: roadmunk_get_field
tools.title: Get a field definition
tools.description: Get one roadmap or account field by id: name, type and, for list fields, the allowed values (first 100; if hasMore is true, pass a higher values_offset); for number fields the format. GraphQL: field(fieldID).

field_id.description: The field id (from roadmunk_get_roadmap) (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

values_offset.description: Number of results to skip (default 0). Use with hasMore in the answer.

tools.name: roadmunk_create_item
tools.title: Create a roadmap item (WRITE)
tools.description: WRITE: create a new item on a roadmap. Changes live data (Roadmunk has no test environment). Give dates OR a bucket, not both. GraphQL: createItem.

roadmap_id.description: The roadmap id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

parent_item_id.description: Make the item a sub-item of this item.

fields.description: Field values to set on the record.

value.description: Value(s) to set, as text. Several only for multi-list fields.

tools.name: roadmunk_update_item
tools.title: Update a roadmap item (WRITE)
tools.description: WRITE: change an item. Only the arguments you pass change. Changes live data. GraphQL: updateItem.

item_id.description: The item id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

fields.description: Field values to set on the record.

value.description: Value(s) to set, as text. Several only for multi-list fields.

tools.name: roadmunk_create_milestone
tools.title: Create a milestone (WRITE)
tools.description: WRITE: create a milestone on a roadmap. Changes live data. GraphQL: createMilestone.

roadmap_id.description: The roadmap id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

fields.description: Field values to set on the record.

value.description: Value(s) to set, as text. Several only for multi-list fields.

tools.name: roadmunk_update_milestone
tools.title: Update a milestone (WRITE)
tools.description: WRITE: change a milestone. Only the arguments you pass change. Changes live data. GraphQL: updateMilestone.

milestone_id.description: The milestone id (from a roadmunk_list_* tool).

fields.description: Field values to set on the record.

value.description: Value(s) to set, as text. Several only for multi-list fields.
